chunks.title: WS-01 spindle evidence review
chunks.body: For this simulated demonstration, review the spindle current-speed residual and exact-machine deviations with a qualified maintenance reviewer. Confirm signal validity and operating context. Do not infer a causal bearing failure or command equipment shutdown from these research observations. Record the review against the existing demo ticket.
